Popular packages standard input structure (MAF object, SummarizedExperiment, phyloseq, GWAS summary statistics, tidy model table) rank bespoke formats. Popularity comes Bioconductor download score (distinct IPs last 12 months, ranked across ~3,100 packages) CRAN downloads September 2026 (cranlogs). Command-line Python tools (MAGeCK, Kraken2, AlphaFold, GROMACS, …) scope outputs common, stable files; popularity GitHub stars, comes small reader (see Readers non-R tool outputs). plotting function’s graphics system (ggplot vs base/grid) checked package source, decides build path. listed: anything already shipped (cnSegmentPlot, seven dittoSeq modules, doseResponse, enrichmentDotPlot, goFanPlot, maPlot, michaelisMenten, survivalCurve, volcanoPlot). Ideas extend one Extensions existing modules.

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: Build path VM base - wrap VizModules base module science-specific data preparation defaults, way volcanoPlot wraps dittoViz_scatterPlot. base named. Cheapest path, inherits stats, annotations, downloads manual-edit persistence. ggplotly - source function returns ggplot survives plotly::ggplotly(); wrap way dittoSeq modules . Native - draw plotly directly standalone plotting function, way cnSegmentPlot() built. Needed source plot base grid graphics (ggplotly() route), stitches panels together (aplot/patchwork), uses geoms plotly translate. Widget - non-plotly htmlwidget Shiny bindings (3D structure). Allowed plotly equivalent, forgoes shared plotly finishing helpers Figure Builder. Tier 1 - popular, standard structure, cheap build. first. 2 - clearly useful, heavier dependencies, native build, narrower audience. 3 - niche costly; build demand. New Suggests - “none (reader)” means module needs small file reader shipped package. FB - Figure Builder: Y module’s input data frame, can registered sci_figure_builder_registry(); N S4 inputs (MAF, SE, phyloseq, …). Upstream? - plot generic enough may belong VizModules rather .

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: maftools de facto reader MAF files (Bioc #154). plots base graphics: oncoplot(), lollipopPlot(), rainfallPlot(), plotTiTv() somaticInteractions() checked source, none call ggplot. ggplotly() route exists, module takes MAF object (read.maf()), pulls tables maftools computes, draws . shared helper converting MAF tidy tables serve every module section. Example data: maftools ships tcga_laml.maf.gz clinical annotations (tcga_laml_annot.tsv) inst/extdata. oncoPlot - Done. recognisable cancer-genomics figure. Gene x sample tiles coloured variant classification, top bar mutations per sample, side bar gene frequency, optional clinical tracks. Build natively plotly subplots sharing axes; tile layer heatmap categorical matrix (getGeneSummary(), getSampleSummary(), subsetMaf()). Tracks come getClinicalData(). Hover per tile big win static plot. mutationLollipop - Done. mutation positions along protein, stem height count, domains rectangles. maftools reads domains bundled protein_domains.RDs; positions come amino-acid change column. Native (segments + markers + shapes). mafSummary - Done. panels plotmafSummary(): variant classification, variant type, SNV class per-sample counts, plotthis_BarPlot getSampleSummary() / getGeneSummary(). One module panel selector, set thin wrappers. mutationalProfile - Done. SBS96 bar chart (six substitution classes x 16 contexts). input standard 96 x sample count matrix produced MutationalPatterns (mut_matrix()), maftools (trinucleotideMatrix()) SigProfiler. Taking matrix (data frame) rather VCFs avoids BSgenome dependency makes Figure Builder compatible. plotthis_BarPlot faceted substitution class, COSMIC colours defaults. MutationalPatterns ships example matrices inst/states. signatureContribution - stacked bars signature exposures per sample (absolute relative), fit_to_signatures() NMF result. plotthis_BarPlot. tiTvPlot - transition/transversion fractions: stacked per-sample bars plus box plot six SNV classes. titv(plot = FALSE) returns tables. vafPlot - VAF distributions top mutated genes; box/jitter plot MAF’s VAF column. dittoViz_yPlot, Stats tab comes free. rainfallPlot - log10 inter-mutation distance genomic position, coloured SNV class, revealing kataegis. distances sorted diff() per chromosome; positions concatenated like cnSegmentPlot’s x-axis (reuse seqlengths helpers). dittoViz_scatterPlot. somaticInteractions - lower-triangle matrix pairwise co-occurrence/exclusivity (Fisher test). somaticInteractions() returns pair table (sigPairsTblSig); draw native heatmap significance markers. tmbComparison - cohort’s tumour mutation burden TCGA cohorts. tcgaCompare() returns median_mutation_burden, mutation_burden_perSample pairwise tests; draw sorted per-sample points per cohort median bars, natively.

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: GWAS summary statistics de facto standard data frame (chromosome, position, p-value, SNP id; MungeSumstats, Bioc #341, harmonises ). qqman’s manhattan() qq() base graphics, plots plain scatters. Example data: qqman’s gwasResults. manhattanPlot - Done. -log10(p) cumulative genomic position, alternating chromosome colours, genome-wide significance lines. data-prep wrapper around dittoViz_scatterPlot, structurally like volcanoPlot. Real summary statistics run millions rows, thin points well significance plotting rely WebGL. Highlight/label lead SNPs via scatter module’s annotation inputs. Nothing p-value specific beyond default transform, per-position statistic (Fst, Tajima’s D, methylation difference, CRISPR tiling scores) plots way. gwasQQPlot - Done. observed expected -log10(p) null diagonal, confidence band genomic inflation (lambda GC) title. dittoViz_scatterPlot plus reference line. Pairs naturally manhattanPlot (input). regionalAssociationPlot - LocusZoom-style view: association around lead SNP, coloured LD, gene tracks. locuszoomr already provides locus_plotly(), returns plotly object, thin wrapper plus finalise stack. needs EnsDb (ensembldb / AnnotationHub) genes , LD, LDlink token. Hence tier 2. variantQC - QUAL, depth allele-frequency distributions per-sample Ti/Tv VCF (VariantAnnotation::readVcf(), info(), geno()). Histograms/densities via plotthis. Niche users QC upstream bcftools. admixturePlot - population-genetics “structure plot”: one stacked bar per individual ancestry proportions K clusters, grouped sorted population dominant component, K selector across runs. ADMIXTURE writes plain .Q matrices (one row per sample, .fam order), LEA’s snmf() / STRUCTURE give shape. reader joins .Q sample population labels; bars plotthis_BarPlot.

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: package already ships DE results (airway_deseq2, airway_edger, airway_voom); modules need counts . airway data package’s SummarizedExperiment natural example. Gene--group expression already covered: dittoPlot accepts SummarizedExperiment (see Extensions). samplePCA - Done. first plot every bulk analysis, thin front-end pcaPlot. takes SummarizedExperiment / DESeqDataSet / DGEList, applies variance-stabilising log-CPM transform, keeps variable genes, builds PCAtools-shaped pca object (PCAtools::pca() installed, otherwise prcomp() packed list) colData metadata. MDS option (limma::plotMDS() coordinates) feeds scores view . pcaPlot - Done. plots PCAtools pca object, omics matrix sample metadata works, just stored SingleCellExperiment. overlaps dittoDimPlot scores view, adds scree, loadings PC-metadata views reduction stored SCE carry. object plain S3 list (rotated scores, loadings, variance %, sdev, metadata, xvars, yvars, components; checked pca()), module needs PCAtools code read . PCAtools stays Suggests, used component-selection helpers examples. Views: Biplot - cbind(rotated, metadata) dittoViz_scatterPlot, PC selectors, % variance axis titles, colour/shape metadata, optional loading vectors top variables native arrow annotations. biplot() ggplot, rebuilding scatter module keeps stats, labels source download consistent. Scree - variance plotthis_BarPlot cumulative % line, reference lines findElbowPoint(), parallelPCA() (Horn) chooseGavishDonoho() / chooseMarchenkoPastur() installed. Loadings - top-N variables absolute loading per selected PC (plotloadings()’s view), dot bar plot loadings. Pairs - scatter grid first k PCs. pairsplot() assembles ggplots cowplot, ggplotly() convert, draw natively plotly subplots. PC-metadata correlation - eigencorplot()’s correlation PC numeric/encoded metadata column, p-values. lattice graphics, compute matrix render ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap (native heatmap stay plotly Figure Builder). PLINK’s --pca output (.eigenvec / .eigenval) converts shape small reader, brings population-genetics PCA extra cost. Example data: PCAtools::pca() airway counts, package’s example_sce logcounts colData. sampleDistanceHeatmap - Done. Euclidean correlation distances samples, colData annotations; standard DESeq2-vignette QC. ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap fed distance matrix data frame. deHeatmap - Done. z-scored expression top-N DE genes (padj/LFC results table) across samples, condition annotations. ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap; module’s job gene selection scaling. pValueHistogram - raw p-value histogram per contrast, check well-calibrated test. plotthis_Histogram. Cheap; uses DE-results data frames package already ships. countDistributions - library sizes, per-sample log-CPM box/density plots, /normalisation side side. plotthis box, density bar modules. meanVariance - vsn::meanSdPlot, DESeq2 dispersion plot, voom mean-variance trend scatter fitted line. dittoViz_scatterPlot. Mostly interest analysts debugging normalisation. wgcnaModuleTrait - WGCNA (32.8k CRAN downloads month) standard co-expression network tool, signature figure module-trait heatmap: correlation module eigengene trait, p-values cells. labeledHeatmap() base graphics (checked), compute cor(MEs, traits) render ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap. views: eigengene expression group (dittoViz_yPlot), gene dendrogram module colour bars (native, hclust object). expressionTrajectories - time-course dose-series clusters: one panel per cluster, gene faint line cluster mean top (Mfuzz soft clusters, DEGreport degPatterns(), TCseq). linePlot group.= gene, facet.= cluster, z-scored expression. rmatsSplicing - rMATS used differential-splicing tool; writes one table per event type (SE, RI, MXE, A5SS, A3SS, *.MATS.JC.txt). Views: dPSI FDR volcanoPlot defaults; event counts type direction (plotthis_BarPlot); per-event PSI group comma-separated IncLevel1 / IncLevel2 columns (dittoViz_yPlot). Sashimi plots (read coverage junction arcs) natural native follow-need BAMs, left .

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: enrichplot / clusterProfiler / DOSE family (Bioc #26, #29, #31) fgsea (#27) dominate. enrichplot’s plots ggplot rarely ggplotly()-friendly: gseaplot2() stacks panels aplot::gglist(), cnetplot() / emapplot() graph layouts (ggtangle, igraph). Build natively underlying data. gseaEnrichmentPlot - Done. running enrichment score, hit ticks ranked metric one gene sets: canonical GSEA figure. fgsea exports plotEnrichmentData(), returns curve ticks, native three-row subplot draws directly. clusterProfiler’s gseaResult running score can recomputed geneList core genes. Native plotly network: igraph layout, edges line segments, nodes markers hover. enrichmentMap - emapplot: terms nodes, edges weighted gene overlap (pairwise_termsim()), clusters related terms. Shares network-drawing helper geneConceptNetwork, build together. gseaRidge - per-term distribution core genes’ fold changes (enrichplot ridgeplot()). enrichplot uses ggridges, ggplotly() translate, dittoViz_yPlot already draws ridges natively, build long table term x gene x fold change. gsvaHeatmap - GSVA/ssGSEA scores (pathway x sample) annotated heatmap. ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap; GSVA returns matrix SE. setOverlapUpset - UpSet overlaps gene lists (DE contrasts, enriched-term genes). Native bars plus dot-matrix subplot. Generic, VizModules candidate (upstream?); Venn diagrams deliberately omitted favour UpSet.

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: Pooled CRISPR screens analysed almost universally MAGeCK (Python), whose outputs stable, documented TSVs: gene_summary.txt (RRA: neg|score, neg|p-value, neg|fdr, neg|rank, neg|lfc pos| mirror; checked), sgrna_summary.txt, count.txt countsummary.txt. MAGeCKFlute (Bioc) post-processes , download rank (#2182) undersells MAGeCK’s reach. One reader serves three modules. crisprScreenRank - Done. genes ranked RRA score LFC top hits labelled, split negative (depletion) positive (enrichment) selection, coloured FDR. dittoViz_scatterPlot x = rank, y = LFC -log10(score); labelling uses scatter module’s highlight inputs. Drill-gene’s guides sgrna_summary.txt second view. crisprBetaScatter - MAGeCK MLE beta scores treatment control, nine-square partition MAGeCKFlute popularised (positive/negative selection one condition, , neither). dittoViz_scatterPlot plus reference lines +/- k SD. screenQC - library-level QC: mapped zero-count guides, Gini index, normalised count distributions per sample (countsummary.txt, count.txt). plotthis bar density modules.

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: dittoDotPlot - Done. expression (colour) x percent expressing (size) per gene per group, standard marker figure. dittoSeq::dittoDotPlot() returns ggplot (checked), fits existing dittoSeq wrapper pattern exactly, new dependencies. cheapest high-value module list. dittoHeatmap - Done. dittoHeatmap(data.= TRUE) returns matrix annotations (checked), ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap can render cell/sample metadata annotation tracks. new dependencies. scQC - per-cell library size, detected features mitochondrial %, MAD-based outlier thresholds drawn reference lines (scuttle::perCellQCMetrics(), isOutlier()). Violin/jitter sample via dittoViz_yPlot, plus detected-vs-library-size scatters. Example data: package’s example_sce. dittoScatterHex - binned two-feature scatter; companion dittoDimHex. ggplotly wrap. dittoPlotVarsAcrossGroups - module/gene-set scores summarised across groups. ggplotly wrap. clonotypePlots - immune-repertoire summaries (clonalHomeostasis(), clonalQuant(), clonalDiversity()). scRepertoire’s functions return ggplots can also return tables (export.table), build plotthis bars dittoViz_yPlot rather ggplotly(). Example data: scRepertoire’s contig_list. daNeighbourhood - miloR’s differential-abundance beeswarm (log fold change per neighbourhood, cell type). dittoViz_yPlot jitter results table.

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: spatialSpotPlot - spots/cells spatialCoords() coloured gene cluster, tissue image underneath. points dittoViz_scatterPlot (y reversed); image (imgRaster()) needs native layout.images layer, since ggspavis’ raster-based plotVisium() go ggplotly() cleanly. Imaging-based platforms (Xenium, CosMx, MERFISH) imaging mass cytometry (cytomapper, Bioc #408) give single cells rather spots: scatter cell centroids, plus segmentation polygons optional native layer. Per-spot scatter-pies (SPOTlight’s plotSpatialScatterpie()) plotly equivalent costly native extra. spatialNeighborhood - cell types sit next chance: imcRtools testInteractions() returns tidy per-pair table (exported, checked), squidpy’s nhood_enrichment z-scores arrive AnnData. cell-type x cell-type ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap significance markers. spatialSVG - spatially variable genes ranked nnSVG / Moran’s (Voyager, squidpy spatial_autocorr), rank scatter whose selection drives spatialSpotPlot. title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: peakAnnotation - share peaks per genomic feature distance--TSS bins, one bar per sample (ChIPseeker::annotatePeak() -> csAnno statistics). plotAnnoPie() base graphics, plotAnnoBar() / plotDistToTSS() ggplot; plotthis_BarPlot stats table covers three. Gviz grid graphics, build natively stacked subplots shared genomic axis. Costly broadly useful; cnSegmentPlot’s axis helpers start. karyogramDensity - feature density (peaks, CNVs, variants) along chromosome ideogram. karyoploteR base graphics, build natively. cnSegmentPlot() already parses cytobands. hicContactMap - Hi-C / Micro-C contact matrices rotated triangle square heatmap locus, TAD loop calls overlaid. Matrices come .cool / .mcool (cooler, Python) .hic (Juicer), read Bioconductor HiCExperiment. Native plotly heatmap; matrices fine resolution large, read visible region.

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: Read- alignment-level QC first thing every sequencing project looks , dominated command-line tools whose outputs plain tables. Nothing needs R package beyond reader. multiqcSummary - MultiQC (GitHub 1.5k stars) aggregates FastQC, STAR, Salmon, Picard, samtools dozens one report, writes data multiqc_data/: general-statistics TSV, per-tool TSVs, since 1.29 stable multiqc.parquet (checked) holding every plot’s data. TSVs need dependency; parquet path use nanoparquet (CRAN, dependency-free) optional Suggests. coverageQC - mosdepth (GitHub 877 stars) standard coverage tool; .mosdepth.global.dist.txt gives fraction bases depth, per chromosome. Cumulative coverage curves per sample (linePlot) mean depth per chromosome target (plotthis_BarPlot, .regions.bed.gz / summary.txt). readLengthQuality - long-read QC: read length mean quality (binned scatter), length distribution N50, yield time, ONT’s sequencing_summary.txt (written MinKNOW/dorado) NanoPlot-style table. dittoViz_scatterPlot plotthis_Histogram; files run millions reads, subsample scatter.

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: proteomicsQC - intensity distributions per sample (/normalisation), identifications per sample, missing-value pattern (DEP plot_missval() view). Plotthis box/bar plus ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap missingness. Takes QFeatures SummarizedExperiment. massSpectrum - centroided spectrum sticks m/z labels top peaks, mirror plot query-vs-library match. Example data: msdata package’s mzML files. chromatogram - TIC, base-peak extracted-ion chromatograms per sample (retention time vs intensity). xcms’ plotting base graphics, chromatogram data extracts cleanly long data frame linePlot. title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: phyloseq (Bioc #87) mia’s TreeSummarizedExperiment (Bioc #177, newer standard) well-defined structures, three core microbiome plots map directly onto VizModules bases. Example data: GlobalPatterns, shipped phyloseq mia. taxaAbundanceBar - stacked relative abundance per sample chosen rank, top-N taxa plus “” (mia::agglomerateByRank(), getTop(); phyloseq::tax_glom()). plotthis_BarPlot. single common microbiome figure. Bracken abundance tables HUMAnN pathway tables (non-R) feature x sample shape reuse via readers. alphaDiversity - richness / Shannon / Simpson group (mia::addAlpha(), phyloseq::estimate_richness(), vegan::diversity()). dittoViz_yPlot, whose Stats tab gives pairwise tests reviewers ask . betaOrdination - PCoA/NMDS Bray-Curtis/UniFrac/Jaccard (vegan::vegdist(), metaMDS(), mia::runMDS()), group colouring optional PERMANOVA title. dittoViz_scatterPlot. phyloTree - phylogenetic tree (rectangular/circular) tip colours annotation strips. ggtree (Bioc #20) standard, since v4 branches use ggiraph geom ggplotly() renders blank (ggtree#682). Compute layout (ape / treeio node coordinates) draw segments natively. rarefactionCurves - observed richness sequencing depth per sample, check sampling deep enough. vegan::rarecurve() base graphics iNEXT’s ggiNEXT() ggplot (checked), compute table first (rarecurve(tidy = TRUE), iNEXT’s iNextEst), linePlot depth line. differentialAbundance - ANCOM-BC (Bioc #178) MaAsLin2 (#266) results log-fold changes CIs per taxon, sorted, coloured significance. title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: Pathogen isolate genomics runs command-line tools stable tabular outputs, gap R plotting ecosystem barely covers. Readers make first-class. taxonomySunburst - Krona-style interactive taxonomy Kraken2 reports (GitHub 939 stars; Bracken re-estimates format). report fixed-column TSV (percent, clade reads, direct reads, rank code, taxid, indented name; checked Kraken2 manual), 8-column variant --report-minimizer-data used, reader handles . Native plotly sunburst / icicle parent-child table, trace type goFanPlot uses. Comparing samples falls taxaAbundanceBar. amrGenePresence - antimicrobial-resistance genes per isolate AMRFinderPlus (NCBI), ABRicate RGI (CARD). isolate x gene presence heatmap annotated drug class (ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap), plus counts per class (plotthis_BarPlot). AMRFinderPlus 4 renamed Gene symbol Element symbol (checked README), reader accepts . antibiogram - phenotypic susceptibility: % susceptible per organism x antibiotic, clinical microbiology lab’s standard summary, S//R proportions per drug. AMR package (CRAN) interprets MIC disk values EUCAST/CLSI breakpoints (.sir()) builds table (antibiogram(), exported, checked). Heatmap via ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap, proportions via plotthis_BarPlot. pangenomePresence - Panaroo / Roary write gene_presence_absence.Rtab, binary gene x isolate matrix. Core / soft-core / shell / cloud partition (piePlot), gene frequency histogram (plotthis_Histogram), presence matrix ordered tree clustering (ComplexHeatmap_Heatmap). Matrices run tens thousands genes, matrix view filters accessory genes.

title: Potential modules for sciVizModules
text: structural-biology output covered yet, AlphaFold made per-residue confidence plots routine. 2D views fit existing stack; 3D viewer one module plotly (allowed flagged exception). alphafoldConfidence - Done. per-residue pLDDT along sequence, banded standard confidence thresholds (linePlot reference lines), predicted aligned error (PAE) residue x residue heatmap, domains show low-error blocks (native plotly heatmap). Inputs: AlphaFold DB / AlphaFold PAE JSON (predicted_aligned_error) pLDDT B-factor column, ColabFold’s *_scores_*.json, carries plddt, pae max_pae (checked source). Multimer predictions add chain boundaries heatmap. jsonlite (already installed plotly) reads JSON. structureViewer - Done. interactive 3D cartoon/surface PDB mmCIF, coloured pLDDT, B-factor, chain user column, residue selection linked 2D plots. NGLVieweR r3dmol export Shiny bindings (NGLVieweROutput() / renderNGLVieweR(), r3dmolOutput() / renderR3dmol(); checked). plotly: Figure Builder panel plotly export, module needs snapshot download path. ramachandranPlot - backbone phi/psi per residue favoured/allowed regions, model validation. bio3d::torsion.pdb() computes angles; reference regions background density contour. dittoViz_scatterPlot, coloured residue type pLDDT. contactMap - residue-residue distance contact map structure MD trajectory (bio3d::cmap(), dm(); plot base graphics, checked). Native heatmap, sharing code PAE view. mdTrajectoryMetrics - Done. standard molecular-dynamics summaries: RMSD radius gyration time, RMSF per residue, hydrogen-bond counts, several replicas overlaid. GROMACS writes .xvg (whitespace columns # comments @ Grace directives carry axis labels legends); MDAnalysis mdtraj users export CSV; bio3d computes rmsd() / rmsf() R. linePlot xvg reader. fscCurve - cryo-EM Fourier shell correlation spatial frequency, 0.143 threshold reported resolution, half-maps masked/unmasked variants. RELION writes postprocess.star (STAR format), cryoSPARC exports curve table. linePlot; STAR reader main cost.

Input coxph/glm fit (tidied module) tidy data frame (term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high). forestplot/forestploter grid graphics, build natively (horizontal error bars + log x-axis). Native (bars + markers), tidy table. decisionCurve - net benefit threshold probability models vs treat-/none (dcurves::dca()). linePlot tidy output.

Normalisation, baseline offset/stacking, reversed x wavenumber/ppm, derivative traces, peak labels. linePlot long table; hyperSpec / ChemoSpec objects convert directly, rxylib (CRAN) reads common XRD spectroscopy instrument formats (.xy, Bruker .raw, …). growthCurve - optical-density growth curves per well/strain logistic fits growth rate, carrying capacity doubling time (growthcurver::SummarizeGrowth()). Build like doseResponse: dittoViz_scatterPlot registered model backend (register_model_backend()). blandAltman - difference vs mean two methods, bias limits agreement reference lines. dittoViz_scatterPlot + computed hlines. Generic (upstream?). qpcrAnalysis - qPCR three views: amplification curves (fluorescence vs cycle, log y, threshold line), melt curves (-dF/dT vs temperature, specificity), delta-delta-Ct relative expression error bars reference gene control condition. linePlot curves; plotthis_BarPlot (linePlot’s error bars) fold change. Instrument exports (QuantStudio, Bio-Rad CFX, LightCycler) CSV/XLSX vendor headers; read readxl plus documented long format. qpcR / pcr (CRAN) reference implementations efficiency correction. plateHeatmap - Done. 96/384/1536-well plate maps raw normalised readouts, control wells marked, Z’-factor per plate, row/column edge-effect summaries. Input table well ID (A01, P24): plate-reader exports, CellProfiler’s per-image CSVs (Metadata_Well), screening data. title: Flexible, Science-Focused Interactive Plotting Modules
text: module follows VizModules trio contract: *InputsUI(id, data, ...) renders controls, *OutputUI(id) renders interactive plotly output, *Server(id, data, ...) holds logic. Every module also ships standalone *App() can run see action. volcanoPlot — differential-expression volcano plot interactive significance fold-change thresholding (wraps VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlot). enrichmentDotPlot — functional-enrichment dot plot -representation / GSEA results (e.g. clusterProfiler output). Enrichment terms sit y-axis, grouping variable (e.g. Cluster) x-axis, dot size encodes gene ratio, dot color encodes significance (-log10 p-value) (wraps VizModules::plotthis_DotPlot). goFanPlot — Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment sunburst (“fan”) plot converts GO DAG clean circular layout, ring hierarchy level segment GO term. Accepts enrichment table GO-ID column numeric column (e.g. qvalue) colour , renders interactive plotly sunburst (wraps GOfan::sunburstGO). Requires GOfan package relevant organism annotation (OrgDb) package (e.g. org.Hs.eg.db). survivalCurve — Kaplan-Meier survival curve fitted survival package. Accepts tidy survival data frame (numeric follow-time column, event status column, optional grouping column) renders interactive plotly curve optional confidence bands, censoring marks, log-rank p-value, median-survival lines, number--risk table. maPlot — differential-expression MA plot: mean abundance x-axis (log10 DESeq2’s baseMean, identity already-logged edgeR/limma columns) log fold change, interactive significance fold-change thresholding volcano plot (wraps VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlot). michaelisMenten — Michaelis-Menten plot enzyme-substrate kinetics, built outputs drc package. module takes data (observed points), model (fitted line) optional stats (nls fit, named K / Vmax coefficients) bundle produced drc Michaelis-Menten workflow. doseResponse — dose-response curve dose log10 axis log-logistic curve fitted drc. drm model backend registered VizModules load, curve one fit options wrapped scatter plot (wraps VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlot). cnSegmentPlot — genome-wide array copy-number segment plot CNSegment object returned sesame::cnSegmentation(). Bin-level log2 signal ratios drawn across genome chromosome guides, centromere marks optional gene labels; several samples stack vertically shared genomic x-axis. forestPlot — forest plot hazard ratios (Cox), odds ratios (logistic) coefficients (linear regression), fitted raw data inside module. Choose outcome covariates interactively, switch one adjusted (multivariable) model one model per covariate; factors show row per level reference level. rocCurve — ROC curves one numeric predictors binary outcome, AUC (DeLong 95% CI pROC installed) legend Youden-optimal cut-marked. Curves AUCs computed package match pROC’s. pkConcentrationTime — pharmacokinetic concentration-time profiles per subject mean ± SD per group, linear log axis, terminal elimination fits. subject’s non-compartmental parameters (Cmax, Tmax, AUC, half-life, CL/F, Vz/F) computed PKNCA computes go source-data download. plateHeatmap — 6- 1536-well assay plates physical layout, raw normalised per plate (percent control, percent inhibition, z, robust z, B-score), control wells outlined, plate’s Z’-factor title, optional row column means spotting edge effects. manhattanPlot / gwasQQPlot — GWAS summary statistics Manhattan plot (chromosomes end end, genome-wide suggestive lines) QQ plot (confidence band, lambda GC). title: Plot DNA methylation array-based copy number segmentation — cnSegmentPlot
text: seg CNSegment object, returned sesame::cnSegmentation(), named list stack several samples vertically shared genomic x-axis. See "Multiple samples" section. genes optional GRanges gene coordinates. gene matched plotted bin overlaps ; identifier added bin's hover text labeled plot – arrow pointing bin single sample, stack several (see "Multiple samples" section). id.col Name metadata column genes holding label display (e.g. gene symbol column). NULL, names(genes) used. centromere optional GRanges per-chromosome centromere coordinates used place chromosome axis ticks dashed guides. NULL (default), centromere positions derived seg$genomeInfo$cytoBand (end chromosome's p-arm "acen" band, .e. p/q boundary); information unavailable, chromosome midpoints used. .plot optional character vector chromosome names (found seqinfo(seg$bin.coords)) restrict plot . NULL (default), chromosomes representing least 1% total genome length shown (small scaffolds/contigs dropped automatically). hover.text.cols Character vector bin.coords metadata column names include point hover text (used returned plot converted plotly). Defaults c("signal", "genes"); columns absent bin.coords ignored. point.size Size bin-level points. Defaults 1.5. point.alpha Opacity bin-level points, [0, 1]. Defaults 0.8. color.low Color low end signal color scale. Defaults "red". color.zero Color 0 point signal color scale. Defaults "grey". color.high Color high end signal color scale. Defaults "green". color.limits Length-2 numeric vector giving c(low, high) limits signal color scale, NULL scale data range. limits must include 0. --bound values squished nearest limit. Defaults c(-0.4, 0.4). color.seg Color segment mean line overlay. Defaults "blue". seg.line.width Line width segment mean line overlay. Defaults 1. centromere.color Color centromere guide lines. Defaults "grey70". centromere.width Line width centromere guide lines. Defaults 0.3. centromere.linetype Line type centromere guide lines (e.g. "dashed", "solid", "dotted"). Defaults "dashed". border.color Color chromosome boundary lines. Defaults "grey80". border.width Line width chromosome boundary lines. Defaults 0.3. border.linetype Line type chromosome boundary lines. Defaults "solid". gene.line.color Color vertical gene guide lines drawn every panel several samples stacked. Defaults "grey40". Unused single sample, anchors labels arrows instead. gene.line.width Line width gene guide lines. Defaults 0.3; use 0 suppress . gene.line.linetype Line type gene guide lines. Defaults "dotted". panel.border.color Color border drawn around panel several samples stacked. Defaults "black". panel.border.width Width per-panel border. Defaults 0.5; use 0 suppress . panel.border.mirror Logical; TRUE (default) panel gets complete rectangle. FALSE, left bottom edges drawn. label.size Plotly font size gene labels (used genes supplied). Defaults 10. free.y Logical; TRUE, stacked sample gets automatically scaled y-axis instead single shared one, y.min / y.max ignored. effect single sample. Defaults FALSE. y.min Optional lower limit y-axis (log2 signal ratio). Values limit squished limit rather dropped. NULL (default) leaves lower bound automatic. y.max Optional upper limit y-axis. Values limit squished limit rather dropped. NULL (default) leaves upper bound automatic. main Optional plot title. NULL (default) empty string leaves plot untitled.

Chromosome tick dashed-guide positions derived seg$genomeInfo$cytoBand (see centromere), gene labels seg$genomeInfo$genes (see genes). title: Plot DNA methylation array-based copy number segmentation — cnSegmentPlot
text: CNSegment object holds single sample. compare several, pass (preferably named) list ; becomes one panel, stacked vertically order supplied first sample top. Panel names taken names(seg), falling back seg.signals$ID column "Sample <>". panels share one genomic x-axis, built union samples' seqinfo, locus lines vertically across whole stack: chromosome tick labels drawn beneath bottom panel, chromosome boundary centromere guide lines run every panel. Samples must agree chromosome lengths (.e. share genome build); error raised otherwise. Gene labels shared . Rather one arrowed annotation per panel, requested gene labeled top panel, vertical guide line (see gene.line.color friends) descending stack gene's position. single sample labels stay anchored bin arrow, . default every panel shares one y-axis peak heights directly comparable; set free.y = TRUE let sample scale independently.

title: Plot DNA methylation array-based copy number segmentation — cnSegmentPlot
text: color scale y-axis support explicit limits (color.limits y.min/y.max, respectively). cases, --bound values squished nearest limit (via scales::squish()) rather dropped, points beyond requested limits remain visible (clamped edge plot/color scale) instead disappearing. signal colorbar shown , color.zero always mapped signal 0, including color.limits asymmetric.

title: Input UI components for the crisprScreenRank module — crisprScreenRankInputsUI
text: module draws gene rank plot pooled CRISPR screen MAGeCK gene summary (read_mageck()): every gene, ranked statistic y-axis, depleted (negative selection) genes left, enriched (positive selection) genes right hits FDR cut-coloured. Every statistic signed: negative depletion, positive enrichment. mageck test (RRA) summary plots log2 fold change, RRA score FDR side (depletion enrichment) gene scores better . mageck mle summary plots beta, z-score FDR one condition, FDR signed beta. wraps VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI(), scatter controls (point highlighting gene, hover data, colours) apply; inputs documented . Genes labelled Annotations tab: list "Points Highlight" (matched gene column, default "Annotate "), select points plot.

title: Input UI components for the crisprScreenRank module — crisprScreenRankInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: metric - y-axis, statistic genes ranked : "lfc" (log2 fold change; beta MLE), "score" (signed -log10 RRA score; z-score MLE) "fdr" (signed -log10 FDR) (default: "lfc") condition - MLE : condition plotted (default: first) fdr.threshold - FDR gene hit (default: 0.05) color.panel - Colours "Depleted", "Enriched" "n.s." (scatter colour picker) VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI() parameters

title: Input UI components for the deHeatmap module — deHeatmapInputsUI
text: user inputs module separated outputs allow flexible UI design. module draws heatmap top differentially expressed genes bulk experiment: genes passing adjusted p-value fold-change cut-offs ranked, top ones taken transformed counts, shown per-gene z-scores across samples, split - -regulated blocks sample metadata annotations. data list holding experiment results, list(object = <SummarizedExperiment>, results = <data frame>), results DESeq2 results() table (DataFrame ), edgeR topTags() table, limma topTable() table adjusted p-value log2 fold change per gene; SummarizedExperiment whose rowData carries columns. Results matched experiment's genes row names, results' row names identifier column. heatmap drawn VizModules::ComplexHeatmap_HeatmapInputsUI(), scaling, clustering, colour, label annotation controls apply; inputs documented . rows carry direction (""/"") log2FC row annotations; every colData column available column annotation, keyed sample column. module plotly. renders InteractiveComplexHeatmap, shared plotly tabs apply, needs ComplexHeatmap, InteractiveComplexHeatmap circlize.

title: Input UI components for the deHeatmap module — deHeatmapInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: de.id.col - Results column matching experiment's row names, "" results' row names (UI: "Gene ID Column", default: whichever matches best) de.label.col - Results column labelling rows, "" identifier (UI: "Gene Label Column", default: symbol similar present) de.padj.col, de.lfc.col - Adjusted p-value log2 fold change columns (UI: "Adj. P-value Column", "Log2 FC Column"; default: recognised DESeq2, edgeR, limma Seurat names) de.padj.cutoff - Keep genes adjusted p-value (UI: "Adj. P-value Cut-", default: 0.05) de.lfc.cutoff - Keep genes absolute log2 fold change least (UI: "|Log2 FC| Cut-", default: 1) de.top.n - genes show (UI: "Top Genes", default: 50) de.rank.- "padj" (significant first) "lfc" (largest fold change first) (UI: "Rank ", default: "padj") de.direction - "", "" "" (UI: "Direction", default: "") de.assay, de.transform - Assay transformation, sampleDistanceHeatmapInputsUI() (default: "counts", "vst" DESeq2 installed, otherwise "log2cpm") Wrapped heatmap defaults set : scale = "Rows" (per-gene z-scores), direction row annotation left rows split , first two colData columns group samples column annotations, row labels size 8, direction colours c(= "#B2182B", = "#2166AC") VizModules::ComplexHeatmap_HeatmapInputsUI() parameters, except matrix.cols rowname.col, module sets

title: Input UI components for the dittoDimPlot module — dittoDimPlotInputsUI
text: user inputs module separated outputs allow flexible UI design. inputs organized tabs via VizModules::organize_inputs() function, columns controlling number columns tab's grid. module wraps dittoSeq::dittoDimPlot(), displays gene expression metadata overlaid dimensionality reduction (e.g. UMAP, t-SNE, PCA) embedding stored SingleCellExperiment, Seurat, SummarizedExperiment object. resulting ggplot converted interactive plotly figure.

title: Input UI components for the dittoDimPlot module — dittoDimPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: var - Gene metadata color (default: first metadata column) reduction.use - Dimensionality reduction plot (default: auto-detected, priority UMAP > t-SNE > PCA) dim.1, dim.2 - dimensions plot x/y (default: 1 2) shape.- Discrete metadata mapped point shape (default: none) split.- Discrete metadata facet (default: none) size - Point size (default: 1) opacity - Point opacity (default: 1) order - Point plotting order (default: "unordered") .label - Draw cluster/group labels (default: FALSE) labels.size - Text size group labels (default: 5) .ellipse - Draw grouping ellipses (default: FALSE) .contour - Overlay kernel-density contour lines (default: FALSE) min.color, max.color - Colors continuous color scales palette.selection - Colors discrete groups (multiColorPicker)

title: Input UI components for the dittoDotPlot module — dittoDotPlotInputsUI
text: user inputs module separated outputs allow flexible UI design. module wraps dittoSeq::dittoDotPlot(), standard marker figure: gene (numeric metadata) group, dot whose colour mean expression cells expressing whose size fraction cells expressing . resulting ggplot converted interactive plotly figure. ggplotly() drops ggplot's size legend, dot-size legend redrawn VizModules::add_size_legend(), VizModules DotPlot module draws : circles sized plotted dots, labelled percentage cells expressing.

what: Plot parameters not implemented or with altered functionality
title: Input UI components for the dittoDotPlot module — dittoDotPlotInputsUI
text: following dittoSeq::dittoDotPlot() parameters available via UI inputs: summary.fxn.size - Always fraction cells non-zero value min, max, mid - Colour-scale limits left dittoSeq ("make") legend.size.title - size legend titled "percent expression", dittoSeq titles main, sub, xlab, ylab, legend.color.title - Plotly allows interactive editing y.labels, y.reorder, x.labels.rotate - exposed; tick angles Axes tab cells.use, adjustment, swap.rownames, slot, split.adjust, categories.*, groupings.drop.unused, .hover, data.- exposed

title: Input UI components for the dittoDotPlot module — dittoDotPlotInputsUI
text: following dittoSeq::dittoDotPlot() parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: vars - Genes numeric metadata, one dot column (UI: "Genes / Variables", default: first five genes) group.- Discrete metadata giving groups (UI: "Group ", default: first discrete metadata column) split.- Discrete metadata facet (UI: "Split (facet)", default: none) scale - Z-score variable's colour values across groups (UI: "Scale", default: TRUE) vars.dir - Direction variables, "x" "y" (UI: "Variables Along", default: "x") assay - Assay (UI: "Assay", default: dittoSeq's default, logcounts present) summary.fxn.color - "nonzero.mean" (dittoSeq's default: mean cells expressing), "mean" "median" (UI: "Colour Summary") min.color, max.color - Colour-scale ends (UI: "Low Color", "High Color"; default: "grey90", "#C51B7D") mid.color - "" two-colour scale, dittoSeq preset "ryb", "rgb", "rwb" (UI: "Mid Color", default: "") size - Largest dot size (UI: "Max Dot Size", default: 6) min.percent, max.percent - Fraction expressing dots smallest largest; groups min.percent get dot (UI: "Min Fraction", "Max Fraction"; default: 0.01, NA)

title: Input UI components for the dittoDotPlot module — dittoDotPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters implementing new functionality also available: size.legend.x - Size legend x position, paper coordinates (UI: "Size Legend X Position", default: 1.04); values just 1 sit right plot size.legend.y - Size legend y position (UI: "Size Legend Y Position", default: 0.35); lower clear colour bar Hiding legend (legend.show) hides size legend . Legend, Axes, Lines Plotly tabs carry shared VizModules inputs (see VizModules::uniform_axes_inputs_ui() siblings).

title: Input UI components for the dittoScatterPlot module — dittoScatterPlotInputsUI
text: user inputs module separated outputs allow flexible UI design. module wraps dittoSeq::dittoScatterPlot(), plotting two continuous variables (genes numeric metadata) SingleCellExperiment, Seurat, SummarizedExperiment object one another, optionally colored third gene/metadata. resulting ggplot converted interactive plotly figure.

title: Input UI components for the dittoScatterPlot module — dittoScatterPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: x.var - Continuous variable x-axis (gene numeric metadata) y.var - Continuous variable y-axis (gene numeric metadata) color.var - Gene metadata used coloring (default: none) shape.- Discrete metadata mapped point shape (default: none) split.- Discrete metadata facet (default: none) size - Point size (default: 1) opacity - Point opacity (default: 1) order - Point plotting order (default: "unordered") .label - Draw group labels group centers (default: FALSE) labels.size - Text size group labels (default: 5) .ellipse - Draw grouping ellipses (default: FALSE) .contour - Overlay kernel-density contour lines (default: FALSE) min.color, max.color - Colors continuous color scales palette.selection - Colors discrete groups (multiColorPicker)

title: Forest plot of model effect estimates — forestPlot
text: data data frame. model One "cox", "logistic" "linear". covariates Character vector covariate column names. time, status model = "cox", follow-time column event column. event column may 0/1 (1 = event), 1/2 (2 = event, survival::Surv() convention), logical, factor/character event label "dead". outcome "logistic", binary outcome column (0/1, logical, two-level factor/character whose second level event); "linear", numeric outcome column. multivariable Logical; fit covariates one model (TRUE) (FALSE). conf.level Confidence level intervals. show.reference Logical; include row factor's reference level. show.table Logical; print estimate, interval p-value beside row. sort."input" keeps covariate order given; "estimate" sorts rows effect size. digits Number decimal places printed estimates. point.color, ci.color Colours estimate markers interval lines. point.size Marker size. ci.width Interval line width. main Optional plot title.

title: Forest plot of model effect estimates — forestPlot
text: plotly object. estimates table draws attached "estimates" attribute.

title: Forest plot of model effect estimates — forestPlot
text: Covariates may numeric (one row, effect per unit) categorical (one row per level, plus row reference level, first factor level). Character logical columns treated factors. multivariable = TRUE covariates enter one model, estimate adjusted others; FALSE covariate fitted (univariable estimates). Rows missing value variable model uses dropped model. Confidence intervals Wald intervals every model type, three comparable; logistic models can differ slightly profile-likelihood intervals confint() gives.

title: Create an interactive GO enrichment sunburst (
text: data data frame enriched GO terms. Must contain term.id column GO identifiers fill column. org Either OrgDb object name installed organism annotation package (e.g. "org.Hs.eg.db", "org.Mm.eg.db", "org.Dr.eg.db"). Defaults "org.Hs.eg.db". term.id name column data holding GO IDs (default "ID"). fill name numeric column data used set segment fill colours (default "qvalue"). palette colour palette used map fill column onto segments. length-one character naming built-plotly continuous colorscale (e.g. "Viridis", "Blues", "RdBu", "Cividis"), two-column [value, colour] matrix/list accepted plotly's colorscale. NULL leaves plotly's default colorscale place. Defaults "Viridis". sub_rect Optional name numeric column data used draw proportional sub-rectangle inside segment (value [0, 1]; count columns converted proportion). NULL "" disables . onto GO ontology category supplied IDs. One "BP" (biological process), "CC" (cellular component), "MF" (molecular function). go.annotation.level.cutoff Numeric cutoff GO annotation levels passed GOfan::sunburstGO() GO_annotation_level_cutoff (default 4). filter.nodes..edge.number Filter sub-graphs edge number (passed filterNodesByEdgeNumber, default 2). fill.na..0 Logical; fill NA values colour column 0 (passed fillNAby0, default TRUE). must.keep Optional character vector GO terms must kept (passed mustkeep). .keep Optional character vector GO terms; branches containing terms kept (passed onlyKeep). ... arguments passed GOfan::sunburstGO().

title: Create an interactive GO enrichment sunburst (
text: input data must contain column GO identifiers (e.g. "GO:0006955") least one numeric column map onto segment fill colour (example q-value -log10 p-value). GOfan::sunburstGO() resolves hierarchical relationships among supplied GO terms using organism annotation database given org, appropriate OrgDb package (e.g. org.Hs.eg.db human) must installed. GOfan::sunburstGO() rendered plotBy = "plotly" returned figure genuinely interactive: hovering segment reveals label clicking segment zooms GO term offspring.

title: Input UI components for the goFanPlot module — goFanPlotInputsUI
text: user inputs module separated outputs allow flexible UI design. module wraps GOfan::sunburstGO() draw Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment sunburst ("fan") plot: GO directed acyclic graph converted circular layout ring hierarchy level segment GO term. figure rendered plotBy = "plotly" interactive (hover read labels, click segment zoom offspring). input data inspected pick sensible defaults: GO-ID column, ontology category (ONTOLOGY column present), numeric fill column (preferring qvalue), optional proportional sub-rectangle column (preferring Count).

title: Input UI components for the goFanPlot module — goFanPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: term.id - GO identifier column (auto-detected) onto - GO ontology category: BP, CC, MF (auto-detected) org - Organism annotation package (e.g. org.Hs.eg.db) fill - Numeric column mapped segment colour (default qvalue) sub_rect - Optional numeric column drawn proportional sub-rectangle (default: none) go.annotation.level.cutoff - GO annotation level cutoff (default 4) filter.nodes..edge.number - Filter sub-graphs edge number (default 2) fill.na..0 - Fill missing colour values 0 (default TRUE)

title: Input UI components for the gwasQQPlot module — gwasQQPlotInputsUI
text: module draws quantile-quantile plot GWAS p-values: observed expected -log10(p) null, y = x line, confidence band, genomic inflation factor (lambda GC). Systematic departure along whole curve suggests inflation (population structure, cryptic relatedness); departure tail expected signature true associations. wraps VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI(), whose inputs documented . Expected values lambda GC computed every variant; thinning (default) drops points plot.

title: Input UI components for the gwasQQPlot module — gwasQQPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: p.col, snp.col - P-value variant columns (default: detected) show.band - Draw confidence band (default: TRUE) ci.level - Confidence level band (default: 0.95) band.color - Fill colour band (UI: "Band Color", default: "#7F7F7F") band.opacity - Fill opacity band, 0 1 (UI: "Band Opacity", default: 0.25) show.lambda - Print lambda GC (default: TRUE) thin, thin.p, thin.fraction - Thinning, manhattanPlotInputsUI() VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI() parameters

text: Shiny tagList containing UI elements

title: Input UI components for the maPlot module — maPlotInputsUI
text: user inputs module separated outputs allow flexible UI design. inputs automatically organized grid layout via VizModules::organize_inputs() function, columns controlling number columns grid. Defaults can set input providing named list values defaults argument. module wraps VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI() adds MA-specific controls. base scatter plot UI components input IDs (e.g. x., y., color., hover.data) documented VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI(); MA-specific additions described . Additional inputs specific MA plots added control significance thresholds colors: sig.: Significance column used grouping (auto-detected: padj, FDR, adj.P.Val, ...) sig.thresh: Significance threshold (default 0.05) fc.thresh: Log2 fold change threshold (default 0) Group colors wrapped module's "Color palette" picker Colors tab, seeded color./ color./ color.ns (defaults: red / blue / lightgray) therefore fully editable covered Reset.

title: Input UI components for the maPlot module — maPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: x.- X-axis variable (auto-detected mean abundance columns: baseMean, logCPM, AveExpr) y.- Y-axis variable (auto-detected effect size columns: log2FoldChange, logFC, LFC) color.- Coloring variable (default: "group", auto-generated thresholds) x.adj.fxn - X adjustment function (default: "log10" log10 mean abundance) show.others - Show others (default: FALSE) hover.data - Hover data columns (default: c("symbol", x., y.)) sig.thresh - Significance threshold (UI: "Significance Threshold", default: 0.05) fc.thresh - Log2 fold change threshold (UI: "LFC Threshold (log2)", default: 0) dittoViz::scatterPlot() parameters also available via wrapped UI

title: Input UI components for the maPlot module — maPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters implementing MA-specific features also available: sig.- Significance column used grouping (UI: "Significance Column") color., color., color.ns - Colors three significance groups, assembled wrapped module's color.panel mapping. named color.panel vector may given instead takes precedence. group - Auto-generated grouping column based sig.thresh fc.thresh

title: Server logic for maPlot module — maPlotServer
code: maPlotServer(   id,   data,   hide.inputs = NULL,   hide.tabs = c("Trajectory", "Facet"),   defaults = NULL )

title: Server logic for maPlot module — maPlotServer
text: id ID Shiny module. data reactive containing data frame plot. Must contain mean abundance (e.g., baseMean, logCPM, AveExpr), effect size (e.g., log2FoldChange, logFC), significance (e.g., padj, FDR) columns. hide.inputs character vector input IDs hide. continuous colour-scale contour controls always hidden, since MA plot colours discrete group column. hide.tabs character vector tab names hide. Default hides: "Trajectory" "Facet". defaults named list default values. Merged module's MA defaults (user values win) used restore state reset. Group colours set color./ color./ color.ns, directly named color.panel vector.

what: Interactive summary of a MAF — mafSummary
title: Interactive summary of a MAF — mafSummary
text: interactive counterpart maftools::plotmafSummary(): six panels summarising non-synonymous variants cohort - counts per variant classification, per variant type per substitution class (silent substitutions included, maftools counts ), variants per sample stacked classification median marked, per-sample spread classification, frequently mutated genes percentage samples mutated .

title: Interactive summary of a MAF — mafSummary
code: mafSummary(   maf,   panels = c("classification", "type", "snv", "per.sample", "box", "genes"),   top.n = 10,   colors = NULL,   show.median = TRUE,   main = NULL )

title: Interactive summary of a MAF — mafSummary
text: maf maftools MAF object data frame MAF columns (see oncoPlot()). substitution-class panel also needs Reference_Allele Tumor_Seq_Allele2, variant-type panel Variant_Type. panels panels draw, "classification", "type", "snv", "per.sample", "box" "genes", order. top.n number genes "genes" panel. colors named vector variant-class colours, overriding maftools' palette classes names. show.median Logical; mark median variants per sample. main Optional plot title.

title: Input UI components for the mafSummary module — mafSummaryInputsUI
text: module draws mafSummary(): six panels summarising non-synonymous variants cohort (counts per variant classification, per variant type per substitution class, variants per sample, per-sample spread classification, frequently mutated genes). data maftools MAF object data frame MAF columns (see oncoPlot()). inputs organised tabs via VizModules::organize_inputs().

title: Input UI components for the mafSummary module — mafSummaryInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: panels - Panels draw (default: six: "classification", "type", "snv", "per.sample", "box", "genes") top.n - Genes top-genes panel (default: 10) show.median - Mark median variants per sample (default: TRUE) palette.colours - Named variant-class colours (multiColorPicker; default: maftools' palette) Legend, Axes Plotly tabs carry shared VizModules inputs.

title: Input UI components for the mafSummary module — mafSummaryInputsUI
text: Jared Andrews

title: Input UI components for the mafSummary module — mafSummaryInputsUI

library(sciVizModules) if (requireNamespace("maftools", quietly = TRUE)) { # The TCGA LAML cohort maftools ships, with its clinical annotations. laml <- read.delim(system.file("extdata", "tcga_laml.maf.gz", package = "maftools"), comment.char = "#") clinical <- read.delim(system.file("extdata", "tcga_laml_annot.tsv", package = "maftools")) laml <- merge(laml, clinical, by = "Tumor_Sample_Barcode") mafSummaryInputsUI("summary", laml) } #>

title: Input UI components for the manhattanPlot module — manhattanPlotInputsUI
text: module draws Manhattan plot GWAS summary statistics: variant's -log10(p) position along genome, chromosomes laid end end alternating colours, genome-wide suggestive significance lines. wraps VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI(), point labelling (annotate./ highlight.points), hover data, colours scatter controls apply; inputs documented . Columns detected usual names (qqman, PLINK, REGENIE, GWAS Catalog harmonised): e.g. CHR / chromosome, BP / POS / base_pair_location, P / p_value, SNP / rsid / variant_id. Large summary statistics thinned default: every variant thin.p kept, plus reproducible thin.fraction rest; source-data download describes plotted (thinned) variants.

title: Input UI components for the manhattanPlot module — manhattanPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: chr.col, bp.col, p.col, snp.col - Chromosome, position, p-value variant columns (default: detected) sig.threshold - Genome-wide significance line (default: 5e-8) suggestive.threshold - Suggestive line (default: 1e-5) thin - Thin non-significant variants (default: TRUE) thin.p - Variants p-value always kept (default: 0.01) thin.fraction - Fraction variants kept (default: 0.25) color.odd, color.even - two alternating chromosome colours seeding colour picker (defaults ; default: dark light blue) VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI() parameters

title: Create a standalone Shiny app for the michaelisMenten module — michaelisMentenApp
code: library(sciVizModules) # Launch with the bundled example kinetics data: app <- michaelisMentenApp() if (interactive()) shiny::runApp(app)  # Launch with custom data: data(mm_kinetics) if (requireNamespace("drc", quietly = TRUE)) {     library(drc)     mm_model <- drm(v ~ S, data = mm_kinetics, fct = MM.2())     mml <- data.frame(S = seq(min(mm_kinetics$S), max(mm_kinetics$S), length.out = 100))     mml$v <- predict(mm_model, newdata = mml)     stats <- nls(v ~ Vm * S / (K + S), data = mm_kinetics,         start = list(K = max(mm_kinetics$v) / 2, Vm = max(mm_kinetics$v)))     app2 <- michaelisMentenApp(mm_kinetics, mml, stats)     if (interactive()) shiny::runApp(app2) } #> Loading required package: MASS #>  #> Attaching package: ‘MASS’ #> The following object is masked from ‘package:plotly’: #>  #>     select #>  #> 'drc' has been loaded. #> Please cite R and 'drc' if used for a publication, #> for references type 'citation()' and 'citation('drc')'. #>  #> Attaching package: ‘drc’ #> The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’: #>  #>     gaussian, getInitial

what: Plot a Michaelis-Menten kinetics fit — michaelisMentenPlot
title: Plot a Michaelis-Menten kinetics fit — michaelisMentenPlot
text: Draws observed reaction velocities substrate concentration overlays pre-computed fitted Michaelis-Menten curve (mml).

title: Plot a Michaelis-Menten kinetics fit — michaelisMentenPlot
code: michaelisMentenPlot(   data,   model,   x = "S",   y = "v",   theme = theme_bw(),   jitter = TRUE,   jitter_width = NULL,   jitter_color = NULL,   jitter_alpha = 0.5,   jitter_size = 1.5,   line_color = NULL,   linetype = "solid" )

title: Plot a Michaelis-Menten kinetics fit — michaelisMentenPlot
text: data data frame observations containing x y columns. model data frame fitted-line coordinates (e.g. mml) containing x y columns data. Drawn fitted curve. x Name column data plot x-axis (substrate concentration). Defaults "S". y Name column data plot y-axis (velocity). Defaults "v". theme ggplot2 theme apply. Defaults ggplot2::theme_bw(). jitter Logical; TRUE (default) observed points plotted (jittered horizontally jitter_width). FALSE, points omitted fitted line drawn. jitter_width Horizontal jitter width observed points. used jitter = TRUE. NULL, ggplot2's default jitter width used. jitter_color Point colour, supplied hex string VizModules colourpicker::colourInput() workflow. NULL, ggplot2's default point colour used. jitter_alpha Opacity observed points, [0, 1]. Defaults 0.5. jitter_size Size observed points, passed ggplot2::geom_point(). Defaults 1.5. line_color Fitted-curve colour, supplied hex string VizModules colourpicker::colourInput() workflow. NULL, "red" used. linetype Line type fitted curve, passed ggplot2::geom_line() (e.g. "solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash", "longdash", "twodash"). Defaults "solid".

title: Plot a Michaelis-Menten kinetics fit — michaelisMentenPlot
code: data(mm_kinetics) if (requireNamespace("drc", quietly = TRUE)) {     library(drc)     mm_model <- drm(v ~ S, data = mm_kinetics, fct = MM.2())     mml <- data.frame(S = seq(min(mm_kinetics$S), max(mm_kinetics$S), length.out = 100))     mml$v <- predict(mm_model, newdata = mml)     michaelisMentenPlot(mm_kinetics, mml, x = "S", y = "v") }

text: user inputs module separated outputs allow flexible UI design. module draws 96-channel single-base-substitution (SBS96) spectrum one samples: six substitution classes, split 5' 3' neighbouring bases, one bar per channel, one panel per sample. input standard count matrix, produced MutationalPatterns (mut_matrix(), 96 channels samples), maftools (trinucleotideMatrix()$nmf_matrix, samples 96) SigProfiler (table channel column column per sample); channels matched name (e.g. "[C>]"), order matter. matrix reshaped long table columns context, substitution, sample, count fraction drawn VizModules::plotthis_BarPlotInputsUI(), every bar-plot control applies; inputs documented . Switch Y value fraction (share sample's substitutions, default) count.

title: Interactive oncoplot of somatic mutations — oncoPlot
text: interactive counterpart maftools::oncoplot(): gene--sample grid non-synonymous mutations coloured variant class (Multi_Hit gene carries one), sample's mutation burden , gene's mutation frequency right, sample annotations tracks . Genes run least often mutated samples sorted oncoplot "waterfall"; orders follow maftools' createOncoMatrix(). Hovering tile gives gene, sample, class protein change.

title: Interactive oncoplot of somatic mutations — oncoPlot
text: maf maftools MAF object (maftools::read.maf()) data frame MAF columns: Hugo_Symbol, Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Variant_Classification, optionally protein-change column (HGVSp_Short, Protein_Change AAChange). Silent variants dropped maftools::read.maf() drops . Sample annotations MAF object's clinical data, data frame columns constant within sample. genes Genes show, NULL top.n often mutated. top.n number genes genes NULL. colors named vector variant-class colours, overriding maftools' palette classes names. clinical.tracks Sample-annotation columns draw tracks. sort.samples Logical; sort samples waterfall. Otherwise keep order MAF. include.unmutated Logical; keep samples none genes mutated. show.tmb Logical; draw per-sample mutation count bar. show.gene.bar Logical; draw per-gene frequency bar. show.sample.names Logical; label samples. background.color Colour unmutated tiles. main Optional plot title.

title: Input UI components for the oncoPlot module — oncoPlotInputsUI
text: module draws oncoPlot(): gene--sample grid non-synonymous mutations, coloured variant class, sample's mutation burden , gene's mutation frequency right sample annotations tracks . data maftools MAF object data frame MAF columns (see oncoPlot()); apps gallery data frame, filtering data table (subtype, say) redraws plot. inputs organised tabs via VizModules::organize_inputs().

title: Input UI components for the oncoPlot module — oncoPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: genes - Genes show; empty top.n often mutated (default: empty) top.n - Number often mutated genes (default: 20) clinical.tracks - Sample annotations drawn tracks (default: none) sort.samples - Sort samples oncoplot waterfall (default: TRUE) include.unmutated - Keep samples none genes mutated (default: TRUE) show.tmb - Per-sample mutation count bar (default: TRUE) show.gene.bar - Per-gene frequency bar (default: TRUE) show.sample.names - Label samples (default: FALSE) background.color - Colour unmutated tiles (default: "#ECF0F1", maftools) palette.colours - Named variant-class colours (multiColorPicker; default: maftools' oncoplot palette) Legend, Axes Plotly tabs carry shared VizModules inputs; Axes tab starts gridlines axis lines (show.grid.x, show.grid.y axis.showline FALSE).

text: Jared Andrews

title: Input UI components for the oncoPlot module — oncoPlotInputsUI

library(sciVizModules) if (requireNamespace("maftools", quietly = TRUE)) { # The TCGA LAML cohort maftools ships, with its clinical annotations. laml <- read.delim(system.file("extdata", "tcga_laml.maf.gz", package = "maftools"), comment.char = "#") clinical <- read.delim(system.file("extdata", "tcga_laml_annot.tsv", package = "maftools")) laml <- merge(laml, clinical, by = "Tumor_Sample_Barcode") oncoPlotInputsUI("onco", laml) } #>

title: Input UI components for the pcaEigencorPlot module — pcaEigencorPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: components - Components correlate (default: first 10; PCAtools components) metavars - Metadata variables (default: ; PCAtools metavars). Non-numeric ones converted integer codes. cor.method - "pearson", "spearman" "kendall" (default: "pearson"; PCAtools corFUN) p.adjust.method - Multiple-testing correction across cells (default: "none"; PCAtools corMultipleTestCorrection) plot.rsquared - Show R-squared rather r (default: FALSE; PCAtools plotRsquared) low.color, mid.color, high.color - Colour scale (defaults: dark blue, white, dark red; PCAtools col) show.values - Print values significance stars cells (default: TRUE) digits - Decimal places printed values (default: 2) Legend, Axes Plotly tabs carry shared VizModules inputs.

title: Pharmacokinetic concentration-time plot — pkConcentrationTime
text: data data frame one row per sample. time, conc, subject Column names sampling time, concentration subject. group Column treatment groups, NULL. dose Column doses (one per subject), NULL. mode "individual" (line per subject) "mean" (group's mean nominal time, interval error.type selects). log.y Logical; log concentration axis. mean mode, lower bound zero, log axis show, drawn smallest concentration plotted instead. show.lambda Logical; draw subject's terminal elimination fit (individual mode). auc.method "lin /log " "linear". colors Named vector colours subjects (individual mode) groups (mean mode). main Optional plot title. error.type interval around mean (mean mode): "sd" (one standard deviation), "sem" (one standard error mean) "ci95" (95% confidence interval mean). error.ci.method "ci95" interval computed: "t" (t distribution n - 1 degrees freedom, default, suits small groups PK study) "normal" (1.96 standard errors). error.bar Logical; draw interval error bars (mean mode). error.ribbon Logical; draw interval shaded band behind group's line (mean mode). error.ribbon.opacity Fill opacity band, 0 1.

title: Read AlphaFold confidence outputs — read_alphafold
text: object class "alphafold_confidence": list plddt data frame index (position along prediction), chain, residue plddt, plus AlphaFold DB category ("high" > 90, "Confident" 70-90, "Low" 50-70, "low" < 50). pae PAE matrix (Angstroms; row = aligned residue, column = scored residue), NULL. max_pae maximum possible PAE reported file, NULL. files files read.

title: Read AlphaFold confidence outputs — read_alphafold
text: Accepted inputs: pae: AlphaFold DB *-predicted_aligned_error_v*.json (current predicted_aligned_error matrix, older residue1 / residue2 / distance arrays), ColabFold *_scores_*.json, holds PAE (pae, max_pae) pLDDT (plddt). confidence: AlphaFold DB *-confidence_v*.json (residueNumber, confidenceScore). structure: predicted model .pdb mmCIF (.cif). AlphaFold writes pLDDT B-factor column, gives pLDDT , multimer, chain residue (read C-alpha atoms). pLDDT comes confidence given, else ColabFold scores, else structure; chain IDs come structure given. AlphaFold 3 *_full_data_*.json output yet supported. AlphaFold DB data available CC-4.0. Please cite Jumper et al. (2021) Nature 596:583-589 Varadi et al. (2024) Nucleic Acids Research 52:D368-D375 using .

text: user inputs module separated outputs allow flexible UI design. module draws sample--sample distance heatmap bulk expression experiment, quality check DESeq2 vignette: counts SummarizedExperiment transformed, variable genes kept, Euclidean distances (Pearson Spearman correlations) samples drawn, samples ordered hierarchical clustering (complete linkage) distances. Replicates sit together; outlier stands apart. heatmap drawn VizModules::ComplexHeatmap_HeatmapInputsUI(), colour, label annotation controls apply; inputs documented . Every colData column available row column annotation; sample identifier sample column (column key). base module's clustering , since re-cluster rows distance matrix Euclidean distance rather use distances . module plotly. renders InteractiveComplexHeatmap, shared plotly tabs apply, needs ComplexHeatmap, InteractiveComplexHeatmap circlize.

title: Input UI components for the sampleDistanceHeatmap module — sampleDistanceHeatmapInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: sd.assay - Assay (UI: "Assay", default: "counts" present) sd.transform - Transformation (UI: "Transformation", default: "vst", DESeq2's variance-stabilising transformation, DESeq2 installed, otherwise "log2cpm"; also "log2" "none") sd.ntop - variable genes used (UI: "Top Variable Genes", default: 500) sd.method - "euclidean", "pearson" "spearman" (UI: "Measure", default: "euclidean") sd.order - "cluster" (hierarchical clustering distances) "data" (object's order) (UI: "Sample Order", default: "cluster") Wrapped heatmap defaults set : scale = "None", clustering , first two colData columns group samples column annotations, blue ramp, dark samples close (low_color, mid_color, high_color), legend titled measure (name). legend title ramp follow measure. VizModules::ComplexHeatmap_HeatmapInputsUI() parameters, except matrix.cols rowname.col, module sets

title: Input UI components for the samplePCA module — samplePCAInputsUI
text: user inputs module separated outputs allow flexible UI design. module draws sample PCA bulk expression experiment, first plot RNA-seq analyses: counts SummarizedExperiment transformed, variable genes kept, samples projected onto principal components (sample_pca()). scores drawn pcaBiplotInputsUI() module, component axes (titled variance explains), loading arrows every scatter control apply; inputs documented . Colour shape choices come colData. see scree, loadings, pairs PC-metadata correlation views PCA, build sample_pca() pass pcaScreePlotServer() friends.

title: Input UI components for the samplePCA module — samplePCAInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: pca.assay - Assay (UI: "Assay", default: "counts" present) pca.transform - Transformation (UI: "Transformation", default: "vst", DESeq2's variance-stabilising transformation, DESeq2 installed, otherwise "log2cpm"; also "log2" "none") pca.ntop - variable genes kept (UI: "Top Variable Genes", default: 500, DESeq2's plotPCA()) pca.center, pca.scale - Centre scale gene PCA (UI: "Center Genes", "Scale Genes"; default: TRUE, FALSE) pca.labels - rowData column naming genes loading arrows, "" row names (UI: "Gene Labels", default: symbol present) x., y., color.- Components axes colour column (default: "PC1", "PC2", first colData column groups samples, skipping sample IDs) pcaBiplotInputsUI() parameters

title: Principal component analysis of a bulk expression experiment — sample_pca
text: object SummarizedExperiment (DESeqDataSet ), numeric matrix features rows samples columns. assay assay use. Default: "counts" present, otherwise first. transform "vst" (DESeq2's variance-stabilising transformation; default DESeq2 installed), "log2cpm" (log2 counts per million, edgeR::cpm() log = TRUE; default otherwise), "log2" (log2(x + 1)) "none" (already-transformed assay). ntop number variable features keep. NA keeps every feature non-zero variance. center, scale Passed stats::prcomp(): centre feature, scale unit variance. feature.labels rowData column whose values name features loadings (e.g. "symbol"), NULL row names. metadata matrix object, optional data frame sample metadata one row per column; ignored SummarizedExperiment, whose colData used.

title: Principal component analysis of a bulk expression experiment — sample_pca
text: list class "pca" elements rotated (sample scores), loadings, variance (percent explained), sdev, metadata, xvars (features), yvars (samples) components.

title: Create an interactive Kaplan-Meier survival curve — survivalCurve
text: Fits Kaplan-Meier survival curve survival::survfit() draws interactive plotly figure. curves confidence bands drawn VizModules::linePlot() curve's step coordinates, band takes line's colour, sits underneath toggles legend.

title: Create an interactive Kaplan-Meier survival curve — survivalCurve
code: survivalCurve(   data,   time,   status,   group.by = NULL,   conf.int = TRUE,   conf.level = 0.95,   conf.type = c("log", "log-log", "plain"),   conf.int.opacity = 0.25,   pval = TRUE,   risk.table = FALSE,   censor = TRUE,   surv.median.line = "none",   fun = NULL,   palette.selection = NULL,   line.size = 2,   break.time.by = NULL,   legend.title = NULL,   pairwise = FALSE,   pairs = NULL,   p.adjust.method = "holm" )

title: Create an interactive Kaplan-Meier survival curve — survivalCurve
text: data data frame containing least time status columns. time name numeric follow-time column. status name event/status indicator column. group.Optional name categorical column stratify curves . NULL "" single overall survival curve (named "") drawn. conf.int Logical; draw confidence band around curve (default TRUE). conf.level Confidence level band, 0 1 (default 0.95), passed survival::survfit() conf.int. conf.type band computed, one "log" (survival::survfit() default), "log-log" "plain". conf.int.opacity Fill opacity band, 0 1 (default 0.25). pval Logical; display log-rank test p-value. applied group.defines one group (default TRUE). risk.table Logical; append "number risk" table beneath curve (default FALSE). table gridlines; time axis zooms curve's. censor Logical; draw censoring marks (default TRUE). surv.median.line Character; draw median survival reference lines. One "none", "hv", "h", "v" (default "none"). Drawn survival probability percentage curves. fun Optional transformation survival curve. One NULL "survival" (survival probability), "pct" (survival percentage), "event" (cumulative events, 1 - S), "cumhaz" (cumulative hazard, -log(S)). band transformed curve. palette.selection Optional vector colors strata, named stratum level (unnamed vector used level order). line.size Numeric width survival curves pixels (default 2). break.time.Optional numeric spacing x-axis tick marks, also sets times risk table counts . legend.title Legend title. Defaults group.stratified. pairwise Logical; also test pair groups (default FALSE). applied group.defines three groups; two, pairwise test global one. See Details read results. pairs Optional list length-2 character vectors naming pairs test, e.g. list(c("Asymptomatic", "Symptomatic")), VizModules::compute_pairwise_stats(). NULL (default) tests every pair. p-values adjusted across pairs tested. p.adjust.method stats::p.adjust() method pairwise p-values (default "holm").

title: Create an interactive Kaplan-Meier survival curve — survivalCurve
text: plotly::plot_ly() object containing interactive survival curve, per-stratum summary (subjects, events, median survival confidence interval, log-rank test) attribute "table". pairwise, attribute "pairwise" holds row per comparison: group1, group2, subjects (n1, n2) events (events1, events2), log-rank chisq p.value, adjusted p.adj p.adjust.method, hazard ratio group2 relative group1 (hr) 95% confidence interval (hr.lower, hr.upper), NA group events model finite estimate.

title: Create an interactive Kaplan-Meier survival curve — survivalCurve
text: input data "tidy" survival format: one row per subject numeric follow-time column status (event) indicator. status column may numeric (0/1 1 = event, 1/2 2 = event, following survival::Surv() conventions), logical (TRUE = event), two-level factor/character level containing "dead"/"death"/"event"/"yes"/"true"/"1" treated event. group.supplied curve stratified column log-rank test p-value (survival::survdiff()) can shown via pval. Comparing three groups. log-rank test global test: asks whether survival differs anywhere among groups, groups differ. pairwise = TRUE three groups, pair also tested subjects (log-rank test two groups, survminer's pairwise_survdiff() computes), results listed plot returned attribute "pairwise". read : p-values adjusted number comparisons made (p.adjust.method, default Holm, keeps chance false positive among nominal level; "BH" controls false discovery rate instead suits screening many groups; "none" overstates significance). Testing comparisons matter (pairs, group control, say) costs less power. adjustment covers comparisons call: picking looking curves, regrouping data something significant, accounted . p-value say large difference . pair also gets hazard ratio (hr) group2 relative group1, Cox model pair, 95% confidence interval: 1, group2 higher hazard (shorter survival). interval adjusted multiplicity, Wald interval can disagree slightly log-rank p-value near significance cut-. log-rank test sensitive one group's hazard constant multiple 's (proportional hazards). Curves cross can hide real difference, hazard ratio averages opposite effects, read tests curves. Groups subjects events give unstable results; survival_lung, ph.ecog's "bed >50%" group single subject, yet comparisons come "significant". Check n1, n2, events1 events2, drop merge sparse groups testing. tests ignore order among groups (stage, dose), trend test powerful, unadjusted covariates: see forestPlot() Cox model covariates. figure built natively plotly rather converted ggplot: plotly::ggplotly() draw stepped confidence band survminer uses.

title: Create an interactive Kaplan-Meier survival curve — survivalCurve
text: Jacob Martin, Jared Andrews

title: Create an interactive Kaplan-Meier survival curve — survivalCurve
code: library(sciVizModules) data(survival_lung) fig <- survivalCurve(survival_lung,     time = "time", status = "status", group.by = "sex" ) if (interactive()) fig  # Cumulative events with a number-at-risk table. fig2 <- survivalCurve(survival_lung,     time = "time", status = "status", group.by = "sex",     fun = "event", risk.table = TRUE )  # Four performance-status groups, each pair compared. fig3 <- survivalCurve(survival_lung,     time = "time", status = "status", group.by = "ph.ecog", pairwise = TRUE ) attr(fig3, "pairwise") #>         group1      group2  n1  n2 events1 events2     test     chisq #> 1 Asymptomatic Symptomatic  63 113      37      82 log-rank  3.456831 #> 2 Asymptomatic In bed <50%  63  50      37      44 log-rank 16.682328 #> 3 Asymptomatic In bed >50%  63   1      37       1 log-rank  5.779873 #> 4  Symptomatic In bed <50% 113  50      82      44 log-rank  8.433446 #> 5  Symptomatic In bed >50% 113   1      82       1 log-rank  5.333335 #> 6  In bed <50% In bed >50%  50   1      44       1 log-rank  1.242310 #>        p.value        p.adj p.adjust.method       hr  hr.lower  hr.upper #> 1 6.299095e-02 0.1259818981            holm 1.443870 0.9781363  2.131361 #> 2 4.419074e-05 0.0002651444            holm 2.453994 1.5723268  3.830049 #> 3 1.621072e-02 0.0648428617            holm 8.488960 1.0442578 69.008280 #> 4 3.683815e-03 0.0184190743            holm 1.713596 1.1862416  2.475389 #> 5 2.092132e-02 0.0648428617            holm 7.559676 0.9939859 57.494471 #> 6 2.650263e-01 0.2650263152            holm 2.998818 0.3939819 22.825694
