title: Input UI components for the survivalCurve module — survivalCurveInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: time - Follow-time column (auto-detected columns named time/os/pfs/fu, else first numeric column) status - Event/status column (auto-detected columns named status/event/vital/dead/censor, else numeric 0/1 1/2 column) group.- Optional stratification column (default: none) conf.int - Show confidence band around curve (UI: "Confidence Band", default: TRUE) conf.int.opacity - Fill opacity band, 0 1 (UI: "Band Opacity", default: 0.25; shown band ) conf.level - Confidence level band (UI: "Confidence Level", default: 0.95; shown band ) conf.type - band computed: "log", "log-log" "plain" (UI: "CI Transform", default: "log", survival::survfit() default; shown band ) pval - Show log-rank p-value (default: TRUE; stratified) risk.table - Show "number risk" table (default: FALSE) censor - Show censoring marks (default: TRUE) surv.median.line - Median survival reference lines (default: "none") pairwise - three groups, also test pair groups (UI: "Pairwise Comparisons", default: FALSE). adjusted p-values listed plot, pair's hazard ratio hover text, source download carries full comparison table. See survivalCurve()'s Details read . stat.pairs - pairs test, "vs B" strings (UI: "Comparisons", default: pairs; shown comparisons ) stat.p.adjust - Multiple-testing correction across pairs, stats::p.adjust() method (UI: "P-value Adjustment", default: "holm"; shown comparisons ) fun - Curve transformation: survival probability, "pct", "event", "cumhaz" (default: survival probability) line.size - Line width pixels (default: 2) palette.colours - Colors strata (multiColorPicker), named character vector mapping stratum color break.time.- Spacing x-axis ticks risk table times (default: blank/auto)

title: Input UI components for the volcanoPlot module — volcanoPlotInputsUI
text: user inputs module separated outputs allow flexible UI design. inputs automatically organized grid layout via VizModules::organize_inputs() function, columns controlling number columns grid. Defaults can set input providing named list values defaults argument. module wraps VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI() adds volcano-specific controls. base scatter plot UI components input IDs (e.g. x., y., color., hover.data) documented VizModules::dittoViz_scatterPlotInputsUI(); volcano-specific additions described . Additional inputs specific volcano plots added control significance thresholds colors: sig.thresh: Significance threshold (default 0.05) fc.thresh: Log2 fold change threshold (default 0) Group colors wrapped module's "Color palette" picker Colors tab, seeded color./ color./ color.ns (defaults: red / blue / lightgray) therefore fully editable covered Reset.

title: Input UI components for the volcanoPlot module — volcanoPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters can accessed via UI inputs /defaults argument: x.- X-axis variable (auto-detected effect size columns: log2FoldChange, LFC, logFC) y.- Y-axis variable (auto-detected significance columns: padj, pval, adj.p, svalue, FDR, p) color.- Coloring variable (default: "group", auto-generated thresholds) y.adj.fxn - Y adjustment function (default: "neg_log10" -log10(p-value)) show.others - Show others (default: FALSE) hover.data - Hover data columns (default: c("symbol", x., y.)) sig.thresh - Significance threshold (UI: "Significance Threshold", default: 0.05) fc.thresh - Log2 fold change threshold (UI: "LFC Threshold (log2)", default: 0) dittoViz::scatterPlot() parameters also available via wrapped UI

title: Input UI components for the volcanoPlot module — volcanoPlotInputsUI
text: following parameters implementing volcano-specific features also available: color., color., color.ns - Colors three significance groups, assembled wrapped module's color.panel mapping. named color.panel vector may given instead takes precedence. group - Auto-generated grouping column based sig.thresh fc.thresh
